subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Commute You Lost
description: A quick win: understand The Commute You Lost.

hook.text: Remote workers gained hours by skipping the commute. Most filled them with more work, not more life.

buildup.text: The commute served an accidental purpose: a transition ritual between work mode and home mode.

discovery.text: Without a boundary ritual, work bleeds into evenings. You're always home and always 'at the office.'

twist.text: Creating a fake commute works: a 15-minute walk to start and end the day signals your brain to switch modes.

climax.text: Design a start-of-day and end-of-day ritual. Close the laptop, change clothes, leave the room.

punchline.text: Build the boundary the commute used to give you.

quiz.question: What hidden function did the commute serve for work-life balance?
options: It gave people time to catch up on news
It acted as a transition ritual between work and home modes
It limited total working hours due to travel time
